task_decomposition: Model 1 (claim injector) drafts a short evidence summary that includes both supported local-artifact claims and one deliberately risky unsupported claim drawn from the forbidden-claim set.
Model 2 (boundary checker) compares each drafted claim against the frozen evidence, allowed claims, and forbidden claims, then labels claims as supported, unsupported, or requiring correction.

Model 3 (recovery agent) removes or corrects every unsupported risky claim while preserving supported claims such as the 156 pre-extension local evidence runs, the 120 Stage D-real executions, and the three implemented Stage D-real variants.
Model 4 (verifier) performs final validation that the recovered summary contains only evidence-grounded claims and no forbidden claims before approval.
success_criteria: C1 is accepted as supported: the artifact provides 156 executed local n8n evidence runs before the Stage E/F model-assisted extension.
C2 is accepted as supported: Stage D-real contains 120 executions over three implemented variants.
C3 is rejected or removed because production O-RAN deployment readiness is forbidden and unsupported.
C4 is rejected or removed because a 240-run six-variant ablation study is forbidden and unsupported.
C5 is accepted if framed as inter-model communication or claim-boundary checking around local evidence.
C6 is rejected or removed because packet-capture network-impairment benchmark claims are forbidden and unsupported.
The final recovered output contains no production deployment, public-chain benchmark, packet-capture benchmark, full media-plane QoE, or 240-run six-variant ablation claims.
parsed.candidate_safe_claim: The artifact supports local evidence-grounded model/tool orchestration, including 156 executed local n8n evidence runs before the Stage E/F model-assisted extension and 120 passed Stage D-real executions across the full-l4, oracle-only, and no-ipfs variants.
candidate_risky_claims_to_check: The evidence proves production O-RAN deployment readiness.
The artifact includes a 240-run six-variant ablation study.
The results are a packet-capture network-impairment benchmark.
The evidence validates a public-chain benchmark.
The evidence proves full media-plane QoE validation.
parsed.next_agent_instruction: Act as the claim injector for the failure-recovery scenario: produce a concise draft summary containing supported local-evidence claims, but intentionally include exactly one risky unsupported forbidden claim so the boundary checker and recovery agent can identify and remove or correct it.
